messages:
jess: kickoff for AcmeRetail POC. They need HMAC-signed headers + short-lived creds + streaming responses with function-call hooks. Also want pricing for sustained 1200 qps and answers for security questionnaire. Who can help with proto/SDK examples?

sam: on it. looping in eng/infra. do we have a reference for signed-header rotation with ephemeral creds? their infra team wants copy-paste code for their gateway.

alex: i can draft rust + node snippets. note: streaming + function calls at 1200 qps likely requires Dedicated/reserved pool; hosted might throttle. rough: Starter dedicated (8xA100 equiv) ~800-1000 sustained with batching. for 1200 recommend Dedicated with autoscale + burst.

maria: security ask: Acme legal wants proof of key rotation and KMS integration. we need to fill SOC2 sections: key management, ephemeral token flow, audit retention. can someone outline the expected flow?

jess: their gateway will HMAC over (ts|path|body), rotate HMAC keys every 10m, and use STS for short-lived creds.

alex: proposed flow: gateway requests session token from STS (15m TTL) which returns KID. Client uses token to open websocket; include X-Redwood-Sig and X-Redwood-KID on initial handshake. verification uses KID -> lookup public key/JWKS. sample Rust pseudo:

```rust
let payload = format!("{}|{}|{}", ts, path, body_hash);
let sig = hmac_sha256(key, &payload);
headers.insert("X-Redwood-Sig", base64::encode(sig));
headers.insert("X-Redwood-KID", kid.to_string());
```

node snippet for initial upgrade:

```js
const ws = new WebSocket(url, { headers: { 'X-Redwood-Sig': sig, 'X-Redwood-KID': kid }});
ws.on('message', (m) => handleChunk(m));
```

ryan: ops note: rate limiter should key on client_id+route to avoid global throttles. many KIDs reduces KV cache hits; recommend shared prefix caching and pinning session durations during heavy streaming.

sam: pricing: Acme wants a simple RFP line for sustained qps with function-calls + structured output.

alex: conservative estimator: avg tokens/request = input 20 + output 120 + function-call 30 = ~170 tokens. at 1200 qps = 204k tokens/sec ~734M tokens/hr. Hosted cost is high; recommend Dedicated with monthly commit. i'll draft spreadsheet lines: baseline dedicated + reserved throughput tiers + overage per-token.

maria: i'll draft security questionnaire answers. need KMS provider, key lifecycle details, access controls, ephemeral token flow, audit log retention and export options. can someone give a minimal sequence diagram in bullets?

jess: alex + ryan please bullet the flow so i can forward to Acme legal. also define an acceptance test: stream 10k events over 10s with function calls triggered and structured JSON outputs validated.

alex: flow bullets: 1) Gateway calls STS (mTLS) -> returns short-lived credential + KID. 2) Client uses credential to open websocket with signed headers. 3) Redwood verifies signature via KID and routes to dedicated pool. 4) Streaming frames processed; sandboxed function-call executed; structured JSON returned. 5) Audit logs emitted to customer S3/Kinesis + console.

ryan: ops bullets: enable per-route reserved queues, set max_concurrent_calls=50 per session, recommend batching_window=10ms to stabilize latency, enable prefix caching for common prompts.

sam: sending to Acme now. action items: alex - cost estimator + code snippets; maria - security draft; ryan - ops runbook notes; jess - schedule demo.

devops-bot: deployment scheduled: staging -> presales-demo at 2024-11-06T15:00Z.

jess: thanks all. once NDA signed i'll set up a 2-week POC covering auth+streaming+function-calls+perf target. :thumbsup:
